plugins.name: inco
plugins.description: Inco brings full-stack, programmable privacy to blockchains. Two skills: Inco Lightning — build confidential smart contracts, dApps, and games on EVM (encrypted types, programmable access control, attestation) — and cToken — integrate Inco's Confidential Token: wrap any ERC-20 into private balances with the @inco/ctoken SDK, sessions, and indexer API.
